'''Kavam''' was one of the main components of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]]. It was a special liquid chemical that could be synthesized,<ref name="TBoB" /> but was also created naturally by the [[Vratix/Legends|Vratix]] secretion glands.<ref name="SoR" />
